name: Life Changes For Keeley
source:
This is the story of what happens to Keeley after she catches her husband, James, cheating on her. You have the option to play as either her estranged husband or as a female artist named Claryce.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/life-changes-for-39333413]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了基莉发现丈夫詹姆斯出轨后的人生变化。你可以选择扮演她关系疏离的丈夫，也可以扮演一位名叫克拉丽丝的女艺术家。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/life-changes-for-39333413]Patreon[/url]]
